title: The iChart WordPress plugin before 2.2.4 does not perform capability or ownership checks in several of its AJAX…
description: The iChart WordPress plugin versions before 2.2.4 lack proper capability and ownership checks in multiple AJAX actions. Instead, they rely solely on a nonce accessible to any logged-in user, including those with the Subscriber role. This flaw allows such users to read, modify, and permanently delete arbitrary posts and overwrite a site-wide option.
